petPolicy: Well-behaved pets are welcome. Please keep them leashed in common areas and clean up after them.
idRequirements: Please present one valid government ID upon check-in for the guest under whose name the booking was made.
policyText:
CAMP ENOKI CANCELLATION & REBOOKING POLICY

Reservation Confirmation
- Booking is confirmed only upon receipt of down payment.

Cancellation Policy
- ALL down payments are NON-REFUNDABLE.
- Cancellations for any reason will forfeit the down payment.
- No-shows will forfeit all payments made.

Rebooking Policy
- One-time rebooking is allowed if requested at least 7 days before check-in.
- Subject to availability.
- Must be used within 6 months from the original booking date.
- Price difference (if any) will be shouldered by the guest.

Weather Policy
- Camp Enoki is a pool resort and remains open during rain or unfavorable weather.
- Weather conditions are NOT valid reasons for cancellation, refund, or rebooking.

Early Check-Out
- No refunds or credits for early check-out or unused stay.

Management reserves the right to update policies when necessary.
